'''Votrad Stadium''' was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Votrad]] on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. It played host to a performance of ''[[The Kallea Cycle]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Galaxywide NewsNets">{{JournalCite|13|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
